Step to test: Generate external_api_errors above configured threshold within configured window and run worker cleanup/alert loop.

Expected result: Dispatcher forwards the item to the screening queue, deletes the dispatch message, and writes DISPATCH_QUEUE_SCREEN_ITEM_FORWARDED audit event.

Test case description: AUD-014 - Dispatcher rejects same queue configuration
Step to test: Set AWS_DISPATCH_SQS_QUEUE_NAME equal to AWS_SCREENING_SQS_QUEUE_NAME and start worker_app.dispatcher.
Expected result: Dispatcher startup fails with a clear configuration error requiring distinct queues.

Test case description: NEG-ADM-001 - Save BU mapping without selected user is blocked

Expected result: API returns HTTP 403 insufficient scope.

Test case description: NEG-AUD-001 - Sensitive query params must be masked in access logs

Test case description: NEG-AUD-002 - 401 auth failures are auditable

Test case description: NEG-AUD-003 - 403 authorization failures are auditable

Expected result: API_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED audit event is present with correlation id.

Test case description: NEG-AUD-004 - High-risk API failure alert is deduplicated within window

Expected result: Only first alert in window is new; subsequent checks do not duplicate alert event.

Test case description: NEG-AUD-005 - Retention cleanup deletes only records older than cutoff

Expected result: Only rows older than retention period are purged.

Test case description: NEG-AUD-006 - SNS publish failure writes audit event

Expected result: SNS_NOTIFICATION_PUBLISH_FAILED event is logged with failure details.

Test case description: NEG-AUD-007 - Malformed SQS message is audited and removed
Step to test: Push invalid message body to screening queue for worker consumption.
Expected result: Worker logs SQS_MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED and deletes malformed message.

Test case description: NEG-AUD-008 - Raw API troubleshooting logs must redact secrets when enabled
Step to test: Enable ACTIMIZE_LOG_RAW_API_IO, execute screening, and inspect emitted application logs.
Expected result: Logged payloads redact bearer tokens, client secrets, client assertions, and similar sensitive values.

Test case description: NEG-AUTH-001 - Missing bearer token is rejected

Test case description: NEG-AUTH-002 - Expired access token is rejected

Test case description: NEG-AUTH-003 - Tampered token signature is rejected

Expected result: API returns HTTP 500 with auth configuration error.

Test case description: NEG-BAT-001 - Unsupported upload extension is rejected by batch-upload API

Test case description: NEG-BAT-003 - Missing upload file is rejected

Test case description: NEG-BAT-004 - Empty upload file is rejected

Test case description: NEG-BAT-006 - Header-only upload is rejected

Test case description: NEG-BAT-007 - Individual row missing required names is rejected

Test case description: NEG-BAT-008 - Invalid gender value in upload is rejected

Step to test: Corrupt uploaded queries.json in S3 before worker dispatch processing.
Expected result: Worker marks job FAILED and logs BATCH_DISPATCH_FAILED audit event.

Test case description: NEG-BU-001 - Single screening without BU is rejected

Test case description: NEG-BU-002 - Single screening with unmapped BU is rejected

Test case description: NEG-BU-004 - Create business unit with blank code fails

Test case description: NEG-BU-005 - Update BU to duplicate code fails

Expected result: API returns HTTP 400 duplicate business unit code error.

Step to test: Call GET /api/v1/screenings/types?business_unit_code=<unmapped> as a user without that BU mapping.
Expected result: API rejects request and does not return Business Unit-specific screening options.

Test case description: NEG-DLY-001 - Schedule page below one is rejected by validation

Expected result: FastAPI query validation rejects the request because page must be >= 1.

Test case description: NEG-RBAC-003 - Analyst cannot read audit events

Test case description: NEG-RES-001 - Summary API failure shows error banner

Test case description: NEG-RES-002 - Recent results API failure shows error banner

Test case description: NEG-RES-003 - Failed row hit dialog shows failure details

Test case description: NEG-SCH-002 - Unknown schedule_id re-run request is rejected

Expected result: Request fails with 400 Daily schedule not found.

Test case description: NEG-SCH-003 - Subscribe API rejects empty email when principal email absent
Step to test: Call POST /screenings/daily-schedules/{id}/subscriptions with empty email and no user email claim.
Expected result: API returns HTTP 400 email is required.

Test case description: NEG-SCH-004 - Unsubscribe nonexistent subscription returns 404
Step to test: Call DELETE subscription endpoint for email not subscribed to schedule.
Expected result: API returns HTTP 404 Subscription not found.

Test case description: NEG-SCH-005 - Remove unknown schedule returns 404
Step to test: Call DELETE /screenings/daily-schedules/{unknown_schedule_id}.
Expected result: API returns HTTP 404 Daily schedule not found.

Test case description: NEG-SCH-006 - Invalid schedule file type blocked in UI
Step to test: In Schedule tab upload unsupported extension and submit.
Expected result: UI blocks submit with CSV/XLSX file type validation message.

Test case description: NEG-SNG-001 - Empty single query payload is rejected
Step to test: POST /api/v1/screenings/match with queries={} .
Expected result: API returns HTTP 400 At least one query is required.

Test case description: NEG-SNG-002 - Viewer non-mock single call is denied
Step to test: Login as viewer and call /screenings/match with mock_screening=false.
Expected result: API returns HTTP 403 Viewer can perform only mock single screening.

Test case description: NEG-SNG-003 - Upstream screening failure normalizes failed response
Step to test: Force Actimize failure during single screening.
Expected result: Item response has status=500 and error text; audit and external error records are written.

Test case description: NEG-SNG-004 - Invalid DOB blocks submission in UI
Step to test: In Single tab enter DOB in invalid format and submit.
Expected result: UI validation blocks submit with DOB format error.

Test case description: NEG-CBK-001 - Callback missing unique key is rejected
Step to test: Post Actimize callback without unique_key.
Expected result: API returns HTTP 400 with unique_key required and no callback row/item update is written.

Test case description: NEG-CBK-002 - Callback invalid status code is rejected
Step to test: Post Actimize callback with status_cd=P or another unsupported value.
Expected result: API returns HTTP 400 stating status_cd must be F or T.

Test case description: STR-001 - Single screening concurrent load
Step to test: Run 50 concurrent single-screening requests for 10 minutes with mixed entities and screening types.
Expected result: System remains stable, no crashes, and p95 response latency stays within agreed SLA.

Test case description: STR-002 - Immediate large batch submit under timeout window
Step to test: Submit a large immediate batch (for example 10k+ records) through batch-upload endpoint.
Expected result: API quickly returns accepted job response and does not time out at gateway/proxy layer.

Test case description: STR-003 - Worker throughput at configured TPS cap
Step to test: Set SCREENING_TPS=32 and run sustained batch load for 30 minutes.
Expected result: Outbound screening call rate is throttled near configured cap without uncontrolled spikes.

Test case description: STR-004 - Queue backlog drain test
Step to test: Create backlog of 100k queue items and run worker with configured parallelism.
Expected result: Backlog drains steadily; worker does not deadlock; jobs eventually complete or fail cleanly.

Test case description: STR-005 - Parallel message processing saturation
Step to test: Increase SCREENING_PARALLEL_MESSAGES and process high-volume batch traffic.
Expected result: Throughput improves up to infrastructure limits without data corruption or duplicate final states.

Test case description: STR-006 - Multi-user concurrent batch submissions
Step to test: Simulate 20+ concurrent users each uploading batch files simultaneously.
Expected result: All submissions receive valid job IDs; no cross-user data leakage; system remains responsive.

Test case description: STR-007 - Polling load on job status endpoint
Step to test: Run 200+ concurrent clients polling /screenings/jobs/{job_id} at configured intervals.
Expected result: Endpoint remains available with acceptable latency and correct progress counters.

Test case description: STR-008 - Midnight schedule burst execution
Step to test: Configure many schedules due at the same minute in America/New_York and run worker loop.
Expected result: Schedules are claimed once each, jobs created without duplication, and next_run_at updates correctly.

Test case description: STR-009 - External API high-latency endurance
Step to test: Inject upstream screening latency (for example 5-10s) during sustained batch load.
Expected result: Worker continues processing with controlled throughput and without queue consumer collapse.

Test case description: STR-010 - External API failure storm handling
Step to test: Force repeated upstream failures above high-risk threshold during a fixed time window.
Expected result: Failures are recorded, high-risk alert is emitted, and worker continues processing remaining items.

Test case description: STR-011 - Operational cleanup on large tables
Step to test: Seed very large audit/access/error tables and trigger retention cleanup cycle.
Expected result: Cleanup completes without service interruption and purges only records older than cutoff.

Test case description: STR-012 - Audit log UI with large dataset
Step to test: Load 50k+ audit events and navigate pages and filters in Audit Log UI.
Expected result: Pagination and filtering remain usable without browser lockup or major rendering issues.

Test case description: STR-013 - Results table stress with large submissions
Step to test: Load submissions producing 20k+ result rows and test search, sort, and pagination.
Expected result: Results interactions remain functional and state changes complete within acceptable time.

Test case description: STR-014 - CSV export with large filtered result set
Step to test: Export CSV from a large filtered dataset (for example 50k rows).
Expected result: Export completes successfully and file contains complete, correctly ordered data.

Test case description: STR-015 - Business unit mapping bulk administration
Step to test: Perform rapid updates for many user-to-BU mappings in admin APIs.
Expected result: Mappings persist correctly, no partial corruption, and API remains stable under burst writes.

Test case description: STR-016 - Schedule subscription fan-out load
Step to test: Subscribe many recipients across multiple schedules and trigger completion notifications.
Expected result: Subscription persistence remains consistent and notification publishing does not block job completion.

Test case description: STR-017 - Worker restart during heavy processing
Step to test: Restart worker process repeatedly while high-volume jobs are in progress.
Expected result: Processing resumes safely, no permanent stuck jobs, and queue messages are eventually reconciled.

Test case description: STR-018 - Duplicate message delivery resilience
Step to test: Simulate SQS duplicate deliveries for same job item under load.
Expected result: Idempotent updates prevent inconsistent final state and job counts remain accurate.

Test case description: STR-019 - Correlation-id traceability under high concurrency
Step to test: Generate high concurrent API, queue, and worker traffic with mixed correlation IDs.
Expected result: Each request path remains traceable end-to-end across access logs, audit events, and error records.

Test case description: STR-020 - End-to-end soak test
Step to test: Run continuous mixed workload (single, batch, schedule) for 24 hours.
Expected result: No memory leak or progressive degradation; error rate and latency remain within acceptable threshold.

Test case description: STR-021 - 20-user shared-file batch benchmark captures timeout behavior
Step to test: Run the retained 20-user same-file batch benchmark against deployed CloudFront using the current performance script.
Expected result: Benchmark output records success count, latency percentiles, and any CloudFront timeout count for regression comparison.

Test case description: STR-022 - Daily schedule pagination under high schedule count
Step to test: Seed hundreds of active schedules and repeatedly page through /daily-schedules as compliance/admin.
Expected result: Responses remain bounded to 10 schedule items per page and page metadata remains accurate under load.

Test case description: STR-023 - Batch run status pagination under high run count
Step to test: Seed thousands of scheduled/ad-hoc runs and page through /daily-schedules/batch-runs as admin.
Expected result: Responses remain bounded to 50 run rows per page and query latency stays within agreed admin-page SLA.

Test case description: STR-024 - Worker delayed retry storm remains controlled
Step to test: Force transient Actimize failures for many queued SCREEN_ITEM messages.
Expected result: Worker requeues within max attempts using bounded delays and does not exceed configured TPS or duplicate completed items.

Test case description: STR-025 - Split queue dispatcher large batch soak
Step to test: Run sustained large batch submissions with split dispatch/screening queues for at least 30 minutes.
Expected result: Dispatch queue remains bounded, screening queue drains steadily, and dispatcher/worker health endpoints remain healthy.
